cells.effect: Production checks disallow DEBUG. Generate .env/.env.example grouped with same keys; .env never committed.
At least 32 random bytes equivalent; no generated production secret; fallback only verifies old signatures for bounded window.
Wildcard hosts rejected by deploy checks unless explicit documented allowlist policy hook.
cells.required: Nonempty explicit hosts in production web role

cells.effect: Default handler timeout 30s; stream routes explicitly opt out with own heartbeat/idle lifetime limits.
Upload memory threshold 2 MiB; total body cap route-specific must permit selected upload maximum; request count/header limits checked separately.
PostgreSQL URL secret required; role-specific credentials supplied; TLS verify-full in production except explicitly trusted local socket policy.
Query timeout may be overridden for migration/backfill command only; pool sizing per process not global.
Namespace required, validated prefix; separate role URLs may override cache/session/broker/results/scheduler clients. No task data in evictable cache instance.
TLS and ACL required outside trusted local development; cluster scripts share hash tags; no automatic SELECT database in cluster.
Secure+HttpOnly+SameSite=Lax in production, cookie Path=/ and no broad Domain default. Browser-close expiry optional.
Opaque reset secret single-use, hashed at rest; token scopes nonempty. Argon2id proposed m=64MiB,t=3,p=1; tune via deployment check benchmark.
Resolve distinct AEAD key from configured secret provider/env reference; never use ordinary Async JSON for plaintext reset secrets. Synchronous mail does not require this key.
Do not inherit bypass for sessions, auth, rate-limit security gates or Async state; these default unavailable/deny.
STARTTLS verification mandatory for production; credentials required if chosen auth mode; no .env values in error output.
Absolute roots supplied at deployment, not embedded in source; private by default; enforce root ownership and symlink-safe access.
Each can explicitly refer to configured Redis alias; all role namespaces separated. No implicit external provider.

cells.default: runtime CPU count bounded 1..32; 1 per slot
cells.effect: Go handler pool default; app may opt into subprocess for hard limits; global limits require coordinator capability.
Lease > 2 heartbeats; Redis-time fencing. Three retries permit four handler executions through Retry; redelivery count separate. Explicit unlimited policy never enabled by default.

Ordinary Retry uses fixed delay unless ETA/countdown supplied; exponential backoff opt-in. Jitter applies to enabled backoff. AutoRetryFor defaults empty; execution lease recovery is a separate policy.
Small terminal dedupe tombstone retained >=7d; active workflow retention overrides; workflow deadline max 7d default; expiry cannot erase live chord barrier.
Occurrence policies mandatory; stable task ID on retry. Hash task/workflow IDs to fixed family partitions; shard-count change requires drained migration, not live config reload.
cells.required: Beat/delay dispatcher; partitions for Async Redis

cells.effect: Site permission gate required; max page size 1000; title custom; audit always enabled for mutations.
Structured redacted logging; export endpoint optional explicit config; readiness false before graceful drain.
